d: When a windstorm blows away the supplies for Stripes’ Animal Party, Blaze transforms into the one Monster Machine strong enough to haul it all back – a Big Rig! There’s nothing he can’t pull with that Big Rig Force!
Blaze and AJ make friends with a space alien named Gormy! But when Gormy’s jetpack loses power, they set out to help him find six special space batteries so he can fly home to his alien family!

Blaze and AJ are spending the day with some very special trucks: Blaze’s family! His Mom, Dad, and little sister Sparkle join Blaze in a race against Crusher to prove they’re the world’s fastest family!
Blaze and AJ are super excited to play their new video game. But when a video game wizard makes the game come alive, Blaze and AJ must level up and save Axle City from pixel pandemonium!
Officer Blaze just got his biggest case yet: tracking down the mischievous Treat Thief! With help from Officer Anna, Blaze sets out to stop the thief and recover every stolen treat!
In their biggest race ever, Blaze and AJ go head-to-head against Crusher to race all the way around the Earth and win the World’s Biggest Trophy!

st: Kalamazoo/Save the Cow Who Jumped Over the Moon!
d: Kalamazoo/Save the Cow Who Jumped Over the Moon!: Ming-Ming visits her Aunt Eleanora at the local petting zoo during a school holiday. Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to take care of her toddler cousin, Marvin, for the afternoon.

st: Save the Armadillo/Save the Itsy Bitsy Spider!
d: The Wonder Pets get a call from a baby armadillo who is afraid his Old West-style town is haunted! The Wonder Pets journey into a watercolor painting to save the Itsy Bitsy Spider who keeps getting washed away.

The Wonder Pets play hide and seek with a gecko in Costa Rica and return to the classroom to find that the precocious gecko! The Wonder Pets get a call from an animal in distress but their phone is broken!

st: Save the Old White Mouse!/The Adventures of Bee and Slug!
d: The Wonder Pets travel to Linny's grandmother's local nursing home to rescue an old white mouse who's stuck in a cuckoo clock. Little Bee and Slug accidentally take the Flyboat for a ride that quickly gets out of control.

Save the Griffin!/Save the Rooster!: The Wonder Pets must become brave knights to rescue a baby griffin in medieval England whose tail is stuck beneath a stone. The Wonder Pets travel to a farm to help a young rooster wake the farm before sunrise.

st: Save the Rat Pack!/Save the Fiddler Crab on the Roof!
d: The Wonder Pets travel to Las Vegas to assist three performing rats who are having trouble working together on their song and dance routine. The Wonder Pets journey to a small village in old Russia to save a fiddler crab.

st: Save the Hound Dog!/Save the Glowworm!
d: The Wonder Pets travel to Memphis to save a baby hound dog in a mansion who is stuck inside a jukebox. The Wonder Pets help a Little glowworm discover what she's good at:  Glowing!
Ollie invites the Wonder Pets to his warren for a sleepover. Tuck wakes up in the middle of the night and finds a visitor in the classroom—an extraterrestrial!

It's summer vacation, and the Wonder Pets rescue a young circus lion named Cubby from falling off a circus train.  The penguin ringmaster is so impressed with the Wonder Pets that he offers them jobs at the circus!

st: Save the Cool Cat & the Hip Hippo!/Tuck & Buck!
d: The Wonder Pets get a call from a Cool Cat and Hip Hippo who are performing at a jazz club in Greenwich Village.  The Cat wants to scat but the Hippo wants to bebop at the same time! Tuck's older cousin Buck comes to the classroom for a visit.

Ollie the Bunny tells the Wonder Pets that a magician put him in a hat and made him disappear! The Wonder Pets get a call from an unhappy Baby Monster who is throwing a tantrum and knocking over buildings in her toy city!

st: Save the Dancing Duck!/Save the Dalmation
d: Ming-Ming decides to explore the classroom in search of action, adventure, and drama.  She enters a diorama and finds a pair of beautiful ballet slippers/The Wonder Pets get a call from a Baby Dalmation in a fire station.

st: A Job Well Done!/Save the Rhino!
d: To celebrate their hundredth save, Linny presents Ming-Ming and Tuck with a special home movie.

st: Save the Raccoon!/Save the Loch Ness Monster!
d: As the Wonder Pets are on their way to rescue a Raccoon stuck in a recycling bin, the Flyboat breaks down! The Wonder Pets must use recycled materials to save the day!

The Wonder Pets get a call from Humpty Dumpty who is teetering precariously on a wall in a pop-up book.  The team must show a colony of Meerkats the joys of voting when they can't agree on how to handle an approaching Jackal.

st: Save the Honey Bears!/Save the Stinkbug!
d: The Wonder Pets journey to Happyland Forest to help two cartoon bears learn how to share. The Wonder Pets get a call from a smelly Little Stinkbug!  The team must show the Baby Stinkbug the joys of taking a bubble bath.

st: Save the Mermaid!/Save the Pony Express!
d: The Wonder Pets fly into a clay diorama to help a Young Mermaid who wants to be a Pirate.  The Wonder Pets must help a Young Pony in the Old West make her first delivery as part of the famous Pony Express!

st: Save the Bat!/Save the Acting Donkey!
d: The Wonder Pets travel to Transylvania to help a Baby Bat who is afraid of the dark.  The Wonder Pets head to the Old Globe Theatre to help a Young Shakespearian-actor Donkey who is not prepared for his performance.

st: Save the Vixen!/Teach an Old Dog New Tricks!
d: In this film noir episode, narrated by Linny, the Wonder Pets must help a Fox whose diamond-studded collar has mysteriously disappeared.

st: Back to Kalamazoo!/Bee and Slug Underground!
d: When Aunt Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to watch little Marvin, Ming-Ming brings the whole team to KalamaZoo!  When Bee and Slug decide to explore what life is like underground, they get stuck in some ooey gooey mud.

st: The Bigger the Better!/Help Little Bo Peep!
d: Ming-Ming flies through the shrink machine the wrong way and becomes enormous!   In this swinging Andrews Sisters-style show, the Wonder Pets get a phone call from Little Bo Peep, who's lost her three singing Sheep.

st: Save the Rock Lobster!/Help the Houseguest!
d: The Wonder Pets travel to Cape Cod to help a Lobster in a lobster trap free himself before the trap is raised. Floppy the Elephant comes to the classroom for a sleepover. But when Floppy gets homesick, the team must help him feel at home.

st: Save the Lovebugs!/Save the Skunk Rocker!
d: The Wonder Pets travel to the Florida Everglades to reunite a pair of quarreling Lovebugs on Valentine's Day./The Wonder Pets get a call from Manchester, England where a Skunk Rocker can't find a band to play with him.

Ni Hao, Halloween: Trick or treat, it's Halloween!  Kai-lan and her friends dress up to go trick or treating with Ye-Ye.  Kai-lan is a dinosaur, Tolee's a panda, Hoho's the Monkey King, and Rintoo is his favorite – a dragon!
Beach Day: Kai-lan is excited because today she's going to the beach with Ye-Ye and her friends, to play in the sand, fly kites, and go in the water!

Roller Rintoo: Kai-lan and her friends are off to a roller rink to go skating!  But when Rintoo won't put on his roller skates, Kai-lan thinks something is wrong.  It turns out that Rintoo is scared of roller skating.

Rain or Shine: Kai-lan and her friends are planning a big day of playing outdoors, when suddenly it starts to rain!  Kai-lan happily finds a way to play in the rain, but Rintoo, Tolee and Hoho are very upset because of the rain.
Ni Hao Kai-lan: Kai-lan and her friends wake up early today because...there's a CARNIVAL in the backyard with game booths, prizes and rides!

Lulu Day: Today, Kai-lan is having a playdate with her best girl friend, Lu-lu the rhino!  Kai-lan is ready with all sorts of games and things to play with Lu-lu.  But Lu-lu wants to play with DIFFERENT things than Kai-lan.
Sports Day: Kai-lan LOVES dinosaurs, and today she's made up a whole bunch of Olympic-style Dinosaur Games to play with her friends!
